name: fmp_exec_compensation
description:
Executive compensation for one company from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/executive-compensation): salary, bonus, stock and option awards and total pay per named officer and year, from proxy filings.
Returns {symbol, executives}: FMP's list of compensation records.
Inputs (* required): symbol* (ticker, e.g. AAPL; upper-cased).
For the current management list use fmp_key_executives.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL"}
